chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad and Fadalah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a mouse and a gecko that fall into the well. He said: “Three buckets are to be drawn from it.”

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well into which the animal falls
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةِ: a mouse; one of the animals mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْوَزَغَةِ: a gecko; another animal mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.ثَلَاثُ دِلَاءٍ: three buckets; the specified amount to be drawn
key_terms.يُنْزَحُ: water is to be drawn out

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a mouse or gecko falls into a well according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the purification of well water when a mouse or a gecko falls into it. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that three buckets should be drawn from the well, indicating a specific measure for restoring ritual purity in this case.
